records.title: Exploring the Effect of Lactium™ and Zizyphus Complex on Sleep Quality: A Double-Blind, Randomized Placebo-Controlled Trial
records.source_title: Exploring the Effect of Lactium™ and Zizyphus Complex on Sleep Quality: A Double-Blind, Randomized Placebo-Controlled Trial
records.abstract: In 171 otherwise healthy adults with mild insomnia, a randomized double-blind placebo-controlled study compared LZComplex3 against placebo after a 7-day single-blind placebo run-in. Over two weeks both arms improved on the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index, but the primary between-group comparison was not statistically significant. Most secondary measures similarly improved in both groups. Four treatment-related adverse events were reported in the active arm, two resulting in permanent discontinuation. The investigators could not conclude that LZComplex3 improves sleep quality after two weeks.
records.relevance_reason: Null primary outcome for a multi-ingredient sleep supplement in a randomized human trial
records.population: Otherwise healthy adults with mild insomnia
records.intervention: LZComplex3 (lactium, Zizyphus, Humulus lupulus, magnesium and vitamin B6)

outcomes.name: Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index
outcomes.finding: Both groups improved, no statistically significant between-group difference on primary endpoint

outcomes.name: Secondary functioning, mood, anxiety and stress measures

records.uncertainty: Two-week treatment, strong placebo response and limited generalizability; combination does not isolate effects of ingredients
records.adverse_effects: Four treatment-related adverse events in active group, two leading to discontinuation
records.limitations: Short trial, non-clinical mild insomnia, placebo response, sponsor involved in study design

provenance.funding_conflicts: Sponsor participated in study design; author disclosures in PubMed
